title: PGA7 rampas 2 tan beras seludup, suspek berusia 22 tahun ditahan
summary: TUMPAT: Serbuan dijalankan Batalion 7 Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA7) di sebuah rumah di Kampung Bunohan, di sini, jam 4.30 petang semalam, membawa kepada rampasan dua tan beras seludup.

title_en: PGA7 seize 2 tons of rice smuggling, arrests 22-year-old suspect
summary_en: TUMPAT: A raid by Battalion 7 Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA7) on a house in Kampung Bunohan, here at 4.30 p.m. last night led to the seizure of two tons of contraband rice.
